proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ G _
  classical
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun v => G.degree v) := by
    intro u v h
    by_contra huv
    exact hcon u v huv h
  have hcard : 1 < Fintype.card V := Fintype.one_lt_card
  have himg : Finset.univ.image (fun v => G.degree v) = Finset.range (Fintype.card V) := by
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (G.degree_lt_card_verts v)
    · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_range, Finset.card_univ]
  have h0 : 0 ∈ Finset.univ.image (fun v => G.degree v) := by
    rw [himg]
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  have h1 : Fintype.card V - 1 ∈ Finset.univ.image (fun v => G.degree v) := by
    rw [himg]
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  obtain ⟨u, _, hu⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h0
  obtain ⟨w, _, hw⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h1
  have hu' : G.degree u = 0 := hu
  have hw' : G.degree w = Fintype.card V - 1 := hw
  have huw : u ≠ w := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hu'
    omega
  have hnadj : ¬ G.Adj w u := by
    intro hadj
    have hmem : w ∈ G.neighborFinset u := (G.mem_neighborFinset u w).mpr hadj.symm
    have hpos := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨w, hmem⟩
    rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree] at hpos
    omega
  have hsub : G.neighborFinset w ⊆ (Finset.univ.erase w).erase u := by
    intro x hx
    have hadj := (G.mem_neighborFinset w x).mp hx
    refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hadj.ne', Finset.mem_univ x⟩⟩
    intro hxu
    rw [hxu] at hadj
    exact hnadj hadj
  have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨huw, Finset.mem_univ u⟩), Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ w), Finset.card_univ] at hle
  omega
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [Nontrivial V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj], ∃ u v : V, u ≠ v ∧ G.degree u = G.degree v
